notes.subject: כי אם
notes.rationale: כי אם wantaim em i min 'tasol' — Hebrew idiom bilong tambu olgeta narapela na livim wanpela tasol

notes.subject: חללה
notes.rationale: meri bagarap — חֲלָלָה: 'wounded/pierced' o 'profane/defiled' — ol tanima i no wankain

notes.subject: אם
notes.rationale: אם long כי אם em i pat bilong idiom, no wanpela tok bilong en long Tok Pisin

translation: Meri i gat man i dai pinis, o meri man i ritim Doti het long en, o meri bagarap, o meri i sleep wantaim man — ol dispela ⟨את⟩ em i no ken kisim; tasol meri i no marit yet, long ol man bilong en olgeta, em i ken kisim olsem meri bilong en.

tokens.gloss: meri i gat man i dai pinis
o meri man i ritim Doti het long en
o meri i sleep wantaim man

tokens.marks: ol dispela (meri i dai pinis man, meri ritim Doti, meri bagarap, meri i sleep wantaim man)
